proposed.explanation: Size is not the distinguishing feature; both types come in various sizes. Material type is independent of head shape; both types are available in carbon steel or stainless. Both types are used in timber and structural applications; head shape determines installation method, not application. Carriage bolts have a rounded head and a square neck underneath that bites into the material, preventing rotation during installation. Hex bolts have a flat hexagonal head that requires a wrench for tightening. Carriage bolt = rounded head + square neck (no wrench needed); hex bolt = hexagonal head (wrench required).
